text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That is—...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to Fuji Kiseki's magic show! 
Today, I'll cast a spell over everyone 
with this mysterious wand!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"An illusion... Sounds interesting. 
......Commencing 'observation.'"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――Hey, Universe! How was the show?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Big Bang"... I experienced the 
"paradox" firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Cognition has encountered an "error" 
regarding the "phenomenon" before me... 
"MYS"...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, curious? Truth be told, I cast a 
spell to misdirect your gaze—using this 
wand, of course.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Magic"...? Neo Universe wants to know 
more about "Magic."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're a curious little pony, aren't you? 
In that case, I'll let you in on a little 
secret.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Lesson one: first, get everyone to notice 
that there's something special about this 
staff.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is... a wand that invites you to a 
wondrous world. With the power emanating 
from this wand, allow me to cast a spell 
on you"... or so she says.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And Lesson 2. Next, use your cane to 
captivate their gaze. Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Now that everyone's attention is focused 
on the wand, Lesson 3. —Take a look in 
your pocket."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……! ……I failed to detect the "intrusion"……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Misdirection is far more important than 
the trick itself. Gaze, gestures, tone, 
and tempo. It demands real technique, 
which is why it's so tough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if it's you, I think you just 
might be able to master it. Would you like 
to try practicing it?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—This staff is the 'Moebius' Staff. With 
this, I will send you a 'signal' from the 
'Twilight Zone' 3 billion light-years 
away...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...How is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, perfect! The word choice in 
particular was so mysterious, it really 
caught my interest!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was able to use... "magic", 
too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's very... Sfera, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps having gotten the knack of it 
from this experience, Neo Universe's 
running became sharper than ever."
